'''Clue scroll (hard)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (hard)|hard]] [[Treasure Trails]].

Requires partial completion of [[The Fremennik Isles]]. You must obtain jester outfit and talk to [[Slug Hemligssen]] before you can talk to [[Mawnis Burowgar]].
